import copy, json
from air_quality import health as h

# Build T chain snapshots, each history extending the previous:
# every entry completes 1 action, cursor advances 1, remaining decreases 1.
T = 8
R0 = T + 2
snapshots = []
for t in range(T):
    history = []
    for i in range(t + 1):
        history.append([
            i, 0, i, 1, False, False,
            {"from_cursor": i, "to_cursor": i + 1, "next_cursor": i + 1,
             "old_done": i, "done": i + 1, "delta": 1,
             "remaining": R0 - (i + 1)},
        ])
    done = t + 1
    remaining = R0 - done
    snapshots.append({
        "state": [done, done, remaining],
        "history": history,
        "retry_chains": [],
        "pending": [],
        "hits": [],
        "summary": [1, done, done, 0, 0, done, remaining],
    })

snap0 = copy.deepcopy(snapshots)
sizes = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
settings = [(1, 1, 2), (1, 1, 3), (2, 1, 2), (2, 1, 4), (5, 1, 8), (6, 1, 2)]
set0 = copy.deepcopy(settings)

# validity: snapshots conform to audit_chain
from air_quality.health import robust_policy_action_audit_chain
for s in snapshots:
    robust_policy_action_audit_chain([s])  # raises if malformed

G = h.audit_trend_grid(snapshots, sizes, settings)
R = h.audit_trend_turns(snapshots, sizes, settings)

assert list(R.keys()) == ["sizes", "settings", "size_changes", "setting_changes", "consistency"], list(R.keys())
assert R["sizes"] == sizes and R["settings"] == [list(s) for s in settings]
W = G["warnings"]; B = len(sizes); P = len(settings)
assert len(W) == B and all(len(row) == P for row in W)

# size_changes: p outer, b=1..B-1 inner
exp_size = []
for p in range(P):
    for b in range(1, B):
        before, after = W[b-1][p], W[b][p]
        if before != after:
            fields = [n for n, o, nw in zip(("level","first_bad","first_good"), before, after) if o != nw]
            exp_size.append([[b-1,p],[b,p],list(before),list(after),fields])
assert R["size_changes"] == exp_size, (R["size_changes"], exp_size)

# setting_changes: b outer, p=1..P-1 inner
exp_setting = []
for b in range(B):
    for p in range(1, P):
        before, after = W[b][p-1], W[b][p]
        if before != after:
            fields = [n for n, o, nw in zip(("level","first_bad","first_good"), before, after) if o != nw]
            exp_setting.append([[b,p-1],[b,p],list(before),list(after),fields])
assert R["setting_changes"] == exp_setting

# consistency
X = [[ [list(W[b][p]) for b in range(B)], G["stability"][p]] for p in range(P)]
exp_cons = [[X[p] == X[q] for q in range(P)] for p in range(P)]
assert R["consistency"] == exp_cons
assert all(isinstance(v, bool) for row in R["consistency"] for v in row)
assert all(R["consistency"][p][p] for p in range(P))
assert all(R["consistency"][p][q] == R["consistency"][q][p] for p in range(P) for q in range(P))

print("W grid:")
for b in range(B):
    print(sizes[b], W[b])
print("size_changes:", R["size_changes"])
print("setting_changes:", R["setting_changes"])
print("consistency:", R["consistency"])

# JSON compatibility + None preserved
s = json.dumps(R)
R2 = json.loads(s)
assert R2 == R

# inputs unmodified
assert snapshots == snap0 and settings == set0 and sizes == [1,2,3,4,5]

# deep-copy independence: mutate returned containers, call again
R["size_changes"][0][2].append(999) if R["size_changes"] else None
R3 = h.audit_trend_turns(snapshots, sizes, settings)
assert R3["size_changes"] == exp_size

# single-point axes -> empty change lists
R1 = h.audit_trend_turns(snapshots, [2], settings)
assert R1["size_changes"] == []
assert list(R1.keys()) == ["sizes","settings","size_changes","setting_changes","consistency"]
R2p = h.audit_trend_turns(snapshots, sizes, [(1,1,2)])
assert R2p["setting_changes"] == []
assert R2p["consistency"] == [[True]]

# exceptions inherited verbatim
for bad, exc in [
    ((snapshots, [], settings), ValueError),
    ((snapshots, sizes, []), ValueError),
    ((snapshots, "x", settings), TypeError),
    ((snapshots, [True], settings), TypeError),
    ((snapshots, [1,1], settings), ValueError),
    ((snapshots, sizes, [(1,1)]), ValueError),
    ((snapshots, sizes, [(0,1,1)]), ValueError),
    ((snapshots, sizes, [(1,True,1)]), TypeError),
    (([], [1], settings), ValueError),
]:
    try:
        h.audit_trend_turns(*bad)
        raise AssertionError(f"expected {exc} for {bad}")
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as e:
        assert isinstance(e, exc), (bad, type(e))

# exported only from health, not package root
assert "audit_trend_turns" in h.__all__
import air_quality
assert not hasattr(air_quality, "audit_trend_turns")
assert air_quality.__version__ == "0.1.0"

print("ALL CHECKS PASSED")
